options.text: Keep investigating and work with others; do not treat the question as finished.
Drop the question, because a hard question is not science.
Treat it as science only after a textbook already prints the full answer.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Alok cannot finish answering "why do rainbows form?" alone in one afternoon.

part_answers.answer: A hard question stays a science question; he should keep investigating and work with others.

teacher.key_rationale: When a science question is hard to answer alone or immediately, keep investigating and work with others instead of treating it as finished.
